does: The Osiris call NotifyCharacterCreationFinished has no body of its own in this build: its registration passes a shared stub that answers true and does nothing, the same one registered for NotifyCharacterCreationSkipped, DebugBreak and RequestModalTutorial.

evidence.says: in code:unplaced::RegisterOsirisGameFunctions the handler stored before the text NotifyCharacterCreationFinished is this function, whose whole body returns true; the macOS build's symbols hold the name esv::OsirisGameFunctions::NotifyCharacterCreationFinished; the decompiler shows it under the name of another folded function, ls::Level::PreLoad
a count-only probe on the stub counts thousands of calls from sixteen unrelated callers in four seconds: the address is shared by folding and a count on it says nothing of this call
The macOS build's symbols hold this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function

questions.ask: what finishes character creation on the server, since this call does not: the creation system's own events (esv::character_creation::CreationFinishedOneFrameComponent) are the candidates
